mapper.select: SELECT p.productid, p.pnm, p.price, g.imgnm, SUM(oi.qty) AS totqty FROM p_order o JOIN p_order_items oi ON o.orderid = oi.orderid JOIN products p ON oi.productid = p.productid LEFT JOIN p_gallery g ON p.productid = g.productid WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY p.productid, p.pnm, p.price, g.imgnm ORDER BY totqty DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

SELECT c.categoryid, c.categorynm, SUM(oi.qty) AS ctgytotqty, ROUND( SUM(oi.qty) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(oi.qty)) OVER(), 0), 2 ) AS ctgyratio FROM users u JOIN p_order o ON u.usrno = o.usrno JOIN p_order_items oi ON o.orderid = oi.orderid JOIN products p ON oi.productid = p.productid JOIN p_category c ON p.categoryid = c.categoryid WHERE 1=1 AND u.gender = #{gender} AND u.birth BETWEEN #{syear} AND #{eyear} GROUP BY c.categoryid, c.categorynm ORDER BY ctgytotqty DESC
SELECT p.productid, p.pnm, p.price, p.categoryid, g.imgnm FROM products p LEFT JOIN p_gallery g ON p.productid = g.productid WHERE p.categoryid = #{categoryid} AND p.DELYN = 'N'
